old_problem: The one-shot injection is named, but the Cscript port-to-physical-UPI mapping, parameter semantics, standard/advanced RAS SKU branch, Windows-compatible OS evidence, deterministic interpretation of `may`, aborts and recovery are not authoritative.
disposition_reason: ED-16 permits no RAS injection until the approved Intel harness, isolated target, oracle and recovery are bound. Unlike row 6, this source provides a bounded one-shot action and coherent failover intent, so the case need not be intrinsically BLOCKED at review layer; however target mapping and optional/contradictory acceptance affect command meaning and PASS, so ED-03 cannot resolve them as simple runtime parameters.
decision_basis: Directly read XLSX Reliability rows 7 and 8 and their same-row DeepSeek content.
Read GPT V2/historical record 2413 and retained exact identity and hashes.
A Cscript `port` must be reconciled to the physical UPI link; the source's wording `Check PCIe slot target` is not sufficient authority.
The standard and advanced CPU RAS branches require a signed SKU capability matrix; optional `may record` cannot form a deterministic PASS rule.
Because the SUT boots Windows, dmesg capture is not substituted for approved WHEA/ETW or vendor evidence.
No BIOS change, target selection, injection, reset, recovery or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Intel UPI data-lane failover with SKU-specific response verification
test_case.purpose: Inject one approved UPI data-lane failover on each mapped socket/link and prove continued system/link operation plus the deterministic standard- or advanced-RAS logging and front-panel response.
required_package: Board/CPU/UPI topology and Cscript socket/port-to-physical-link map
CPU standard-versus-advanced RAS SKU capability declaration
Approved Intel ITP/CScripts version/hash and exact parameter semantics
Abort, degraded-link recovery and BIOS restoration procedure
test_case.test_command: Execution remains conditional. A qualified Intel FAE must snapshot state, apply only approved BIOS settings, validate `pcie.topology()`/`pcie.port_map()` against the physical UPI map, invoke `ei.injUpiDataLinkFailover(socket,port,1,0x3)` once on the approved target, resume, capture complete Windows/ITP, BMC, recovered UEFI, link-health and physical-indicator evidence, then restore settings and link health under the approved procedure.
test_case.expected_result: The selected physical UPI link performs the approved data-lane failover/degradation while the system remains within the defined normal-operation envelope; exact log and fault-light behavior matches the declared standard or advanced RAS SKU branch; recovery and BIOS restoration succeed.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved target mapping and SKU branch, complete one-shot transcript, deterministic expected-versus-observed link state, workload/health continuity, exact required per-SKU records/indicator state and restored baseline. `May record`, generic dmesg grep, an unmapped port, missing evidence, crash, persistent degradation or recovery failure is not PASS.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle isolated SUT, stable power, independent console and qualified FAE approval.
Preserve pre-state logs/topology/settings and cross-check physical UPI target before injection.
Stop on wrong target, uncontrolled degradation, lost console, crash, thermal/power anomaly or no-boot.
Do not auto-repeat, reset, retrain, power-cycle or restore debug settings outside the approved recovery.
expected_evidence: Harness hash, topology/port-map and selected physical link rationale
Complete injection transcript and pre/post link-health/normal-operation data
Approved Windows, BMC and recovered UEFI records
Recovery, BIOS restoration and engineer-owned verdict
test_case.recovery: Use only the approved vendor sequence to stop further injection, restore/retrain the specific link if required, recover the OS and compare every BIOS debug setting with baseline. Preserve evidence and require separate approval for any reset, power cycle or rerun.
